name: elemental-air-above-the-weather
brief: Above The Weather. Open sky at altitude: no ground, no horizon, only drift. Breath made audible by two flutes trading short phrases, wind chimes and glass mallets sparkling above them, Csus2 harmony that never resolves. No percussion kit and no bass weight: gravity is the wrong element. The outro disperses upward into the intro wind bed at the loop point rather than landing.
title: Above The Weather
_genre_is_instrumental: Measured, not inferred. music/prompts/elemental-air.md, section '## Lyrics guidance': 'Instrumental. Leave the **lyrics box empty** - that is Suno's instrumental path.' _generation_request.style: <494-char caption from music/prompts/elemental-air.md>, with ', instrumental, no vocals' appended - the deployed translate.py appends that cue itself when instrumental=true and lyrics is empty
_generation_request.title: Above The Weather
_generation_request._styleWeight_reason: D1: the deployed translate.py computes bpm = int(60 + styleWeight*120) when styleWeight is set, else bpm = 120. styleWeight 0.2667 -> int(60 + 32.0) = 92, the genre anchor. Without it the render comes back at 120 BPM, 1.30x the anchor.
_generation_request._structure_variant_b: send the template tag sheet (6 tags, 16/16/32/16/32/16 bars) as 'lyrics' AND append ', instrumental, no vocals' to style yourself - translate.py only appends that cue when lyrics is empty, so a non-empty lyrics box must carry the cue
_generation_request._key_warning: D2: the deployed translate.py sets key = req.style, so the ACE keyscale receives the whole 494-character caption. Send the ACE plan directly, or accept the malformed keyscale.

_duration_basis: 92 BPM, 4/4 -> one bar = 4*60/92 = 2.608696 s. 128 bars = 333.913 s -> plan duration 334 s (SunoGenerateRequest.duration is Optional[int]). Inside the planner rail (planner.py MIN_DURATION_S=30, MAX_DURATION_S=420). The binding check is the family rubric: music/rubrics/gamer.json criterion loop_safety states 'duration_s * bpm / 240 should land near a whole bar count' -> 334*92/240 = 128.03 bars. 128 = 8 x 16-bar phrases, so every section boundary in the tag sheet (16/16/32/16/32/16) is a whole phrase. Tradeoff recorded as O3: 334 s is 1.80 plays of the 600 s loop-10min shape (600 s = exactly 230 bars at 92 BPM); the exact-divisor alternative is 115 bars = 300.000 s, rejected because 115 = 7x16+3 breaks the phrase grid.

binding: loop_safety (weight 3: bar math + tail/head RMS within ~6 dB + no fade-to-silence on a loop claim)
asset_packaging (weight 1: stated BPM and key, stems time-aligned, loop-point marker)
loudness_target (weight 1: -14 LUFS +/-1 for the streaming lane)
_rubric.not_binding: chip_timbre_authenticity is scoped 'chiptune-8bit only'; battle_energy (weight 3) is id-scoped '(elemental-*, epic-orchestral-boss)' but the rubric's own notes say elemental-* tracks choose per their prompt - elemental-air is a 92 BPM suspension theme with no percussion by genre rule, so a literal read of battle_energy scores it 1. Finding F2, for the rubric owner.
reject_signals_that_apply: fade-out or truncated ending on a game-loop claim
no stated BPM/key for a game-asset product
